Container.Name: Box3balans
Container.Overview: Self-hosted overview of your investments, crypto and precious metals, with the Dutch box 3 wealth tax: what you had on 1 January, the tax under the current system, the actual return, and a yearly dossier of where every amount comes from. Connects to Bitvavo, Kraken, Coinbase and Interactive Brokers (read-only keys), reads wallets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Cardano and other chains, and imports exports from DEGIRO, Trade Republic and others. The interface is in Dutch, with English available. Open source (AGPL-3.0); your data stays on your server.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Port of the web interface. Don't open it to the internet: use a VPN such as WireGuard or Tailscale to reach it from outside.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database and the encryption key created on first start (keep a copy of app-secret in your password manager).

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Automatic backups, for your own backup tool to copy off-site.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for days and peildata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as and who owns its files (Unraid: 99, nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (Unraid: 100, users).

Config.Name: Backup passphrase
Config.Description: Encrypts the automatic backups. Recommended; keep it in your password manager.

Config.Name: Ankr API key
Config.Description: Free key from ankr.com, only needed for BNB Chain wallets.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: true when you reach the app through HTTPS (a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: true behind a reverse proxy, so the app sees your own IP address.
